title: Isa de Burgh – CPG Brand Architect Portfolio
description: Isa de Burgh's portfolio site is a refined, editorial-style personal website for a CPG brand architect and creative director. The design uses a sophisticated serif typography system with generous whitespace and a restrained color palette of black, white, and warm beige. The hero features a centered, elegant layout with the name in a refined serif font above a brief one-line description. Work samples are presented as a full-bleed image grid with titles overlaid on hover. Each project page uses the same editorial approach — large photography, minimal text, and careful typographic hierarchy. The navigation is a thin, unobtrusive top bar. The design draws heavily from print editorial — magazine-style layouts, pull quotes, and carefully considered image-text ratios. There are no heavy animations or flashy elements; the design relies on quality of content and typographic craftsmanship. The site feels personal, premium, and uncompromising in its design standards. A 'Contact' link opens a simple email prompt. The portfolio demonstrates that for creative professionals, the website itself must be the best portfolio piece.
primary_use_case: Perfect reference for creative directors, brand strategists, and designers needing a refined editorial portfolio that lets work photography and typography lead.
style_vibe: Refined editorial minimalism with premium serif typography, generous whitespace, and photography-led portfolio presentation.
